subclassFeature.name: Fortune Arcana Sorcery
entries: Fortune has given birth to those with exceptionally strong wills. The souls of those blessed by Fortune possess the strange ability to attract both luck and calamity. As your power grows, you begin to perceive countless possible futures and the threads that connect them.

You receive a Tarot Deck as your Spellcasting Focus. This Tarot Deck is spiritually connected to your soul and can be summoned or dismissed at will. Your Tarot Deck is unique to you, and you may give it any name you wish. Once bonded to you, it remains with you for the rest of your life.
Remember... Fortune has chosen you. You cannot refuse this blessing, even if that blessing resembles a curse.

subclassFeature.name: Fortune Arcana Spells
entries: Your connection to Fortune grants you additional spells. These spells count as Sorcerer spells for you and do not count against the number of Sorcerer spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Read the Threads
entries: You can perceive the threads of fate surrounding living creatures.

When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes a D20 Test, before you know whether the roll succeeds or fails, you can use your Reaction to read the creature's path of Fortune. You may add or subtract 1d6 from the D20 roll.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest. Alternatively, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to use this feature without expending one of its uses.

subclassFeature.name: Fortune Deck Fate
entries: Your Tarot Deck contains the Major Arcana of Fortune. At 3rd level, you unlock the first five cards. You can draw cards a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest, or spend 2 Sorcery Points to draw a card without expending a use.
When you draw a card, roll 1d5 and determine the card using the Arcana Cascade table. Cards 6 through 22 become unlocked as you gain Sorcerer levels.

Drawing a card is a Special action and does not require an action unless otherwise specified by the card. You cannot draw and store multiple cards. You can have only one active card at a time. If you draw another card, the previous card immediately disappears.
You may spend 3 Sorcery Points to draw a specific card that you have already unlocked instead of rolling for a random card.

entries.caption: Arcana Cascade
rows: Leap of Fate: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 feet makes a D20 Test. Reroll the D20 and you must use the new result. After the reroll, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Manifest Will: When a spell you cast deals damage, add 2d6 Force damage to one target. If the spell is a Cantrip, add 1d6 Force damage instead.

Veil Beyond Sight: Reaction when you or an ally within 60 feet is attacked. The target gains +4 AC against that attack. If the attack misses, the target may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Abundance of Life: When a creature within 60 feet receives Healing, increase the amount healed by 2d6 + your Charisma modifier. If the creature has less than half its maximum HP, increase the healing by an additional 1d6.
Decree of Fate: Reaction before a Saving Throw. An ally gains +1d8 to the Saving Throw, or an enemy suffers -1d8 to the Saving Throw.

Sacred Guidance: Reaction when an ally makes a D20 Test. Add 1d10 to the roll. If the bonus causes the roll to succeed, the ally gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Charisma modifier. If it does not cause the roll to succeed, the bonus is lost.

Fated Bond: Bonus Action. Link two creatures you can see for 1 minute. If one target is an enemy, damage that enemy deals to you is halved, and the remaining damage is dealt to the enemy. This transferred damage ignores Resistance and Immunity. If both targets are allies, whenever one linked creature takes damage, half the damage is dealt to the other linked creature. Whenever one linked creature receives healing, the other receives the same amount of healing.
Ride the Fated Path: Bonus Action. Move up to 30 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If you deal damage with a spell during this turn, add 3d8 Force damage.

Unbreakable Fate: Reaction when you or an ally takes damage. Reduce the damage by 4d10 + your Charisma modifier. If the damage is reduced to 0, the target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the amount of damage absorbed.
Hidden Truth: Bonus Action. For 1 minute, you gain Truesight out to 30 feet and have Advantage on Perception, Investigation, and Saving Throws.
Turn the Wheel: Reaction when you or an ally makes a D20 Test. Reroll the D20 with Advantage and add your Charisma modifier to the result. You must make the new roll yourself.
Balance Must Be Paid: Reaction when an enemy deals damage. That enemy takes damage equal to the damage it dealt. This damage cannot be reduced or prevented.

Suspended Fate: Reaction when a creature you can see within 120 feet takes damage or fails a Saving Throw. Suspend the effect until the end of your next turn. At the end of your next turn, you may choose any creature you can see within 120 feet to receive the suspended effect instead.

Inevitable End: Reaction when a creature you can see is attacked. The target makes a Death Save. On a failure, if the target has 10% or less of its maximum HP, it dies immediately. Otherwise, it takes 10d10 Necrotic damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. If this damage kills the target, you regain all expended Sorcery Points.

Perfect Balance: Action. Choose up to six creatures. You may redistribute or transfer Hit Points among the chosen creatures by a total amount equal to the combined levels of all chosen creatures. Each chosen creature also gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d10 + your Charisma modifier.

Pact of Ruin: Bonus Action. Concentration, up to 1 minute. Curse a creature you can see. Whenever the cursed creature deals damage, it takes 2d8 Psychic damage. Whenever you deal damage to the cursed creature, it takes an additional 4d6 Psychic damage.

Cataclysm of Fate: Action. Detonate an explosion in a 20-foot radius. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity Saving Throw, taking 12d8 Force damage plus 12d8 Lightning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. A creature that fails is also Paralyzed and knocked Prone. A creature that succeeds is knocked Prone.

Miracle: Reaction when you or a creature you can see fails a Saving Throw or suffers a Critical Hit. Negate the triggering effect and heal the creature for 12d12 + your Charisma modifier Hit Points. You also remove conditions and negative effects as if the creature had been affected by Heal.

Reality Beneath the Veil: Action. Create an illusionary area with a 60-foot radius for 1 minute. A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must make a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure, an enemy has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls, cannot take Reactions, and its Speed becomes 10 feet. On a success, an enemy has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and its Speed is halved. As a Bonus Action, you may move the area.

Radiant Destiny: Bonus Action. Create a 60-foot aura centered on yourself for 1 minute. Allies in the aura gain an AC bonus equal to your Charisma modifier, Advantage on Saving Throws, and regain 2d12 + your Charisma modifier Hit Points at the start of their turn while inside the aura. Once per turn, an ally in the aura also deals an additional 2d8 Radiant damage when it hits with an attack or deals damage with a spell. Enemies take 4d8 Radiant damage when they start their turn inside the aura.

Final Judgment: Action. Choose up to six creatures within 120 feet. Each target makes an Intelligence Saving Throw. On a failure, a target takes 15d10 Radiant damage plus 15d10 Psychic damage and becomes Stunned. On a success, the target takes half damage and suffers no Stunned condition.
Rewrite Fate: Action. Alter one aspect of reality as though casting Wish, but without suffering any negative consequence from doing so. Once used, you cannot use this card again for 1d4 days.

subclassFeature.name: Omens of Fate
entries: Fortune begins sending you warnings before important events occur.

Whenever you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest, roll two d20s and record the results. Whenever you or a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, you may replace the result with one of the recorded rolls. You must decide to replace the roll before knowing whether the original roll succeeds or fails.
Once a recorded result is used, it is lost. You can have a maximum of two recorded results at a time.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
A Short Rest taken to activate this feature requires you to spend the entire Short Rest meditating.

subclassFeature.name: Fate's Reflection
entries: You can capture the threads of fate as they unfold.
When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, you can use your Reaction to record the result for 10 minutes.

During that time, when you see a creature within 60 feet make a D20 Test, you may replace its result with the recorded D20 result. You must choose to replace the roll before knowing whether the original roll succeeds or fails.
Once the recorded result is used, it disappears. You can have a maximum of two recorded results at a time.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Fate Sovereign
entries: You have become a sovereign of Fortune itself.
When you use Fortune Deck: Fate to draw a card, you may choose any card you have unlocked instead of rolling randomly. You can choose a card this way three times per Long Rest.

After all three uses have been expended, you may continue drawing cards normally using the uses granted by Fortune Deck: Fate or by spending 2 Sorcery Points to draw a card without expending a normal use.
When you use an ability from Arcana Cascade to draw an additional card, you may also choose the card yourself. Each card chosen this way counts toward the three uses of this feature per Long Rest.
